title: Training Note — Repeat Kestrel Auto Finance Borrowers and the Down Payment Percentage on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rule.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, a proven Kestrel Auto Finance borrower pays a lower down payment percentage. The standing is read from the buyer's Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts: whether a contract is paid off, the installment payments posted across all the buyer's contracts, and any returned-payment entries.

| Buyer's Kestrel Auto Finance record | Down payment percentage falls by |
|---|---|
| one of the buyer's contracts is paid off, no payment on any of the buyer's contracts has ever been returned, and at least 6 installments (the repeat minimum) have been paid across the buyer's contracts | 2.5 points (the clean repeat points) |
| a contract is paid off and at least 6 installments have been paid, but a payment has been returned | 1.0 point (the recovered repeat points) |
| any other record | nothing |

The reduction never takes the down payment percentage below the tier's minimum down payment percentage.

**Questions answered.**

*The buyer paid off a contract after 36 on-time installments. How far does the percentage fall?* 2.5 points.

*The buyer paid off a contract after 5 installments and has no other contract.* Nothing: fewer than 6 installments have been paid.

*The buyer has paid 6 installments across two contracts, one of them paid off, and one payment was returned two years ago.* 1.0 point.

*The buyer has 40 installments on an active contract but no contract paid off.* Nothing.

*The percentage on the order stands 5 points above the tier's minimum. What does a clean repeat borrower pay?* 2.5 points above the tier's minimum.

*The percentage on the order stands at the tier's minimum.* It stays at the tier's minimum; the reduction cannot take it lower.
